data: Trace gas analysis at Mars; relay for ESA and NASA surface missions
Added for PRD-023 Slice A — active Mars orbiter rendered as 3D glyph on /explore.
TGO mission status (ESA Mars Express + ExoMars)

ESA's Trace Gas Orbiter, in orbit at Mars since 2016. Sniffs the atmosphere for methane and water vapor that could hint at biology or geology, and relays data for Mars surface missions via its UHF relay.
ESA flagship to Jupiter — first orbiter ever to settle around a Galilean moon (Ganymede, 2034)
First spacecraft to orbit a comet (67P)
ESA's first Mars orbiter; Europe's first planetary mission
First European Moon mission — solar-electric ion drive. Spiralled to the Moon over 13 months; deliberate impact 2006-09-03
First close-up images of a cometary nucleus — flew 596 km past Halley's Comet at 68 km/s in 1986
Sample-returned Bennu (2023); now en route to Apophis
